paragraphs.text: The Numbered Ones were the most powerful wizards from the Kingdom of Khone .

The Khonians gathered all promising spellcasters into the Khone Valley of Sacrifice and forced them to survive using magic. The strongest were sent to Sol'Kanar the Swamp King on the Date of Tribute . The young wizards were given Khonian numbers instead of their names – Ahn, Tal, Thu, Fah, Fif, Ska, Gyd, Jate, Nah, Tak, Eloh, Twal, Thutri, Fahtri, Fiftri, Skatri, Gydolien, Jatetri, Nahtri and Venali, and were domineered by Khonian midwives .
They were blinded when the explosion of a Yalomar Cat killed all the Numbered Ones except the one named Gydolien Mor .
